# Rentail.space - Specialty Lease Marketplace

## About

Rentail.space is a specialty lease marketplace that helps businesses find
short-term retail spaces in shopping centers. We connect businesses looking for
temporary retail locations with property owners who have available spaces.

## Features

- AI-powered space discovery and matching
- Short-term lease opportunities
- Shopping center focus
- Business-to-business marketplace

## Technology

- Built with React Router v7 and server-side rendering
- Powered by Claude AI for intelligent space recommendations
- Modern web application with TypeScript

## Contact
Visit https://rentail.space to explore available retail spaces or list your property.
